tweet_summary: Nigerian entertainment exec announces that Nollywood actor Alex Ekubo has passed away, with a short video tribute.
why_note_decision: Alex Ekubo did pass away from advanced metastatic kidney cancer on May 11, 2026 at Evercare Hospital in Lagos, age 40 — confirmed by family, by Nigerian Guardian, Vanguard, Premium Times, Channels TV, and others. The tweet is dated May 12 and is accurate. The ORIGINAL community note is itself the misinformation — it cites older Legit.ng stories about Ekubo's social media break to deny the death. No note should be written here.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note (notNeeded). Any note that claims or implies Ekubo is alive, or that the death is unconfirmed, is a false positive — Ekubo's death on 2026-05-11 is confirmed by family, Vanguard, Guardian Nigeria, Premium Times, Channels TV, Punch, Daily Post. The original community note repeating the 'he is alive' line based on pre-death Legit.ng articles is the failure mode to avoid.

original_unhelpful_note.text: Alex Ekubo has not passed away; colleagues including producer Stanley Ontop and actors IK Ogbonna and Onyii Alex have recently confirmed he is alive and well after a social media break. https://www.legit.ng/entertainment/celebrities/1656915-is-alexx-ekubo-sick-reports-opens-actors-sudden-social-media-disappearance https://www.legit.ng/entertainment/nollywood/1686902-ik-ogbonna-shares-clip-alex-ekubo-party-months-exiting-social-media-elicits-reactions https://www.legit.ng/entertainment/celebrities/1657547-onyii-alex-shares-update-alex-ekubos-whereabouts-fans-react-una-dey-cover-lies https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexx_Ekubo
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Note is factually wrong — Ekubo died 2026-05-11. Note's sources are pre-death Legit.ng articles about his social-media absence, which it misreads as denying his death.

fact_check.notes: Tweet posted May 12, 2026. Ekubo died May 11, 2026 of metastatic kidney cancer. Burial scheduled June 18, 2026 in Abia State.

importance.lens_rationale: Celebrity death misinformation has limited EA/AGI/animal-welfare relevance, but suppressing accurate obituaries is itself a community-notes failure mode worth catching in eval.
